faq.title: A few common questions before getting started.
faq.description: Short answers, clear expectations and real support behind the platform.

items.question: Do we need technical knowledge to use LumoraEvents?
items.answer: No. LumoraEvents is designed for event teams, with clear setup and close support whenever needed.

items.question: How do judges submit scores during the competition?
items.answer: Judges score from a clean interface on tablet or mobile, keeping the process fast and easy to read live.

items.question: Can it adapt to our own competition rules?
items.answer: Yes. Scoring logic, judging flow, categories and timings can be adjusted to fit the way your event already works.

items.question: Does it work well on any device?
items.answer: Yes. The platform is designed to run smoothly in modern browsers on mobile, tablet and desktop.

items.question: Will we have support during the event day?
items.answer: Yes. We are available before, during and after the event so operational questions do not turn into stress.

items.question: Can the audience follow the competition live?
items.answer: Yes. Schedules, participants and results can be shared through a live public experience with clear visibility.

items.question: Do we need to install anything?
items.answer: No installation is required. LumoraEvents runs in the browser, making rollout simple for teams and judges.

meta.title: Cookie Policy | LumoraEvents
meta.description: Learn how LumoraEvents uses necessary and analytics cookies, and how you can change your preference at any time.

hero.title: How LumoraEvents uses cookies.
hero.description: This page explains what cookies are, which ones we use and how you can decide whether analytics cookies are allowed.

summary.title: At a glance
items: Necessary cookies keep essential site functions working.
Optional analytics cookies only load after your consent.
If you accept optional cookies, LumoraEvents uses Google Analytics 4.
You can review or change your choice at any time from the footer.

sections.title: What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser to remember useful information about your visit.
They can help a site function correctly, remember preferences or measure how people use the pages.

sections.title: Necessary cookies
paragraphs: Necessary cookies support essential technical functions and cannot be disabled from the preference panel.
Without them, some parts of the site may not work as expected.

sections.title: Optional / analytics cookies
paragraphs: Optional cookies are used for analytics and measurement. If you accept them, LumoraEvents loads Google Analytics 4 to understand visits, navigation patterns and the performance of public pages.
If you reject them, Google Analytics is not loaded.

sections.title: How to change your preference
paragraphs: On your first visit you can choose Necessary only, Accept all or open Configure to decide manually.
You can also open Cookie settings later from the footer and update your preference whenever you want.

cookiesPage.contactNote: If you need help or want to ask anything about this policy, you can contact us at info@lumoraevents.net.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | LumoraEvents
meta.description: Learn what data LumoraEvents may process through the website, for what purposes and how you can exercise your privacy rights.

hero.title: How LumoraEvents handles personal data.
hero.description: This page explains what data may be processed through the public website, why it may be used and how you can exercise your rights.

summary.title: At a glance
items: Possible data: information you send by email and navigation or usage data if you accept optional analytics cookies.
No automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects are carried out through this public website.

sections.title: Controller
paragraphs: LumoraEvents is responsible for the personal data that may be processed through this public website.
For any privacy-related request, you can contact info@lumoraevents.net.

sections.title: What data may be processed
paragraphs: Depending on how you interact with LumoraEvents, limited personal data may be processed.
items: Information you send by email to info@lumoraevents.net.
Basic usage and measurement data collected through Google Analytics 4 only if you accept optional cookies.

sections.title: Purposes of processing
paragraphs: Personal data may be processed to respond to inquiries, manage communications related to your message and improve the public website through aggregated analytics when optional cookies have been accepted.

sections.title: Legal basis
paragraphs: The legal basis may be your consent, the application of pre-contractual measures at your request or the legitimate interest in managing the public website and its security, depending on the context.
Google Analytics 4 only operates on the basis of consent when optional cookies are accepted.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Data will be kept only for as long as necessary to handle the relevant request, maintain the communication or comply with legal obligations.
Analytics data is subject to the retention settings configured in Google Analytics 4 once consent has been granted.

sections.title: Recipients and providers
paragraphs: Data may be processed by service providers needed to operate the website and communication channels.
items: Google as provider of Google Analytics 4 when optional cookies are accepted.

sections.title: User rights
paragraphs: You may request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction or portability when applicable by writing to info@lumoraevents.net.
You also have the right to withdraw consent at any time when processing is based on consent, including optional analytics cookies.

sections.title: Complaints and automated decisions
paragraphs: If you believe your rights have been infringed, you may file a complaint with the supervisory authority that is competent in your country or region.
This website does not use personal data for automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

meta.title: About | LumoraEvents
meta.description: LumoraEvents was born from real events, grows alongside real organizers and stays close before, during and after each competition.

hero.title: We are two entrepreneurs from Mallorca building a platform from real events.
paragraphs: We come from two worlds we care deeply about: dance and technology. After years connected to competitions and events, bringing both experiences together felt like a natural step.
LumoraEvents was born there, and also from a very simple idea: staying close to organizers, judges and participants where the real work of an event actually happens.

story.title: We were part of the organization and saw the operational chaos up close.
paragraphs: Spreadsheets on one side, emails on another, separate tools and too much energy spent simply trying to coordinate everything.
That is where LumoraEvents began: in a real environment, from repeated needs and with the idea of making the work clearer, more organized and better supported.

work.title: We work closely, listen carefully and believe support is part of the experience.
work.description: For LumoraEvents, this is central. It is not about handing over a tool and disappearing, but about supporting the process and continuing to refine it with each organizer.

phases.title: Before the event
phases.description: We listen to how each organization works, where the current friction points are and which practical details cannot be lost along the way.

phases.title: During the event
phases.description: We stay close so that any question, adjustment or issue does not become an extra layer of pressure for the team.

phases.title: After the event
phases.description: We review what was learned, gather the small details and keep improving from real use, not from a distant roadmap.

philosophy.title: We prefer clarity over unnecessary complexity.
philosophy.description: We try to build with calm judgment, adapting to how each event works and avoiding layers that only make the work more complicated.

items.title: Simplicity
items.description: If something can be understood with fewer steps and less noise, that is usually the better path.

items.title: Clarity
items.description: When an event is moving, every decision needs to be understood quickly and without ambiguity.

items.title: Adaptability
items.description: Each competition has its own way of working. The goal is not to impose a structure, but to support it well.

items.title: Constant evolution
items.description: We keep adjusting, correcting and learning because real events always teach something new.

items.title: Listen before deciding
items.description: The best improvements almost always begin with an honest conversation with the people organizing.

items.title: Stay close
items.description: Closeness is not a communication layer. It is a way of working.

items.title: Avoid the unnecessary
items.description: We do not add complexity just to look more complete.

items.title: Build from reality
items.description: What matters is what helps in a real event, not what sounds better in the abstract.

closing.title: LumoraEvents keeps growing in the same way it began: close, listening and learning from real events.
closing.description: That is what we also want this page to reflect: behind LumoraEvents there is not a startup talking about itself, but real people building alongside real people.
